_about: Starter vocabulary for a software estate: what exists, what it depends on, and why it is the way it is. A FIRST DRAFT to edit.
_summary: Software estate: systems, components, interfaces, data, environments, decisions and risks.
name: Architecture Knowledge Base

classes.System: A named application or platform that a team owns and a user or another system consumes.
classes.Component: A part of a system deployed or released as a unit: a service, a job, a library, a front end.
classes.Interface: A contract others depend on: an API, an event topic, a file feed, a database view.
classes.DataStore: A place data lives: a database, a bucket, a queue, a cache, a warehouse table.
classes.Environment: A place components run: production, staging, a region, a tenant.
classes.Team: The group accountable for something. Attach ownership to a team, not to a person.
classes.Capability: A business capability the estate supports. This is what the business asks about.
classes.Requirement: A stated need, functional or otherwise, that something must satisfy.
classes.DecisionRecord: A recorded architecture decision: the choice, the alternatives, the reason, the consequences.
classes.Risk: A known way this can hurt: a single point of failure, an end of support, a concentration.
classes.Runbook: The documented way to operate or recover something.
classes.Document: A source document in the corpus: a design, a review, a standard, a transcript.
classes.Repository: Where a component's code lives: a source repository, recorded before it exists (intended) and observed once it does.

consumes: A contract something depends on. This is where coupling lives.
depends_on: The consumer needs the provider to work. Usually derived from consumes and exposes, and stated only when a document says so.
writes_to: A component writing this store. Two writers to one store is worth knowing about.
decided_by: The recorded decision that shaped this.
supersedes: This replaced that. Use with the temporal fields, never by overwriting.
implemented_by: The repository that holds this component's code.

owner: The organisation or account that owns the repository.
name: string
The repository's name within its owner.
default_branch: The branch a checkout lands on.

url: The base URL a caller reaches the interface at, when it has one.
